# Bed Edge Chamfer

Edges on the print bed with no chamfer or fillet, where the first layer spreads.

<figure markdown="span">
![Bed Edge Chamfer: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/bed-edge-chamfer-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Bed Edge Chamfer: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/bed-edge-chamfer-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>A chamfer on edges at the bed, for the squashed first layer to spread into.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [FDM](../../reference/processes/fdm-3d-printing.md) | Low |

## Values

This rule has no number to meet: when it finds the problem, it reports it as the error or warning set here.

Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | If detected | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | Warning | Published, [UltiMaker](../../citations/bibliography.md#ultimaker-fdm "Chamfer edges on the bed for elephant's foot"), [Hubs](../../citations/bibliography.md#hubs-fdm) |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, PLA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU (Flexible), PA, PA-CF (Carbon Fiber), PC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Sharp edges on the bed: `{feature}` sits on the bed with `{size}`. The first layer is squashed and spreads sideways (elephant's foot), so the base comes out wider than drawn and holes there narrower, which spoils fits. Add a 0.5 to 1 mm, 45° chamfer along these edges.
!!! failure "Error"

    Sharp edges on the bed: `{feature}` sits on the bed with `{size}`. The first layer is squashed and spreads sideways (elephant's foot), so the base comes out wider than drawn and holes there narrower, which spoils fits. Add a 0.5 to 1 mm, 45° chamfer along these edges.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
